description: This file is a C++ source code for a sensor injection utility in an Android environment. It provides functions to inject simulated sensor data such as accelerometer, magnetometer, gyroscope, hinge angle, and device orientation, primarily for testing purposes. The main function parses command-line arguments to perform specific sensor injections.

methods.name: startSensorInjection
methods.description: Initializes sensor injection mode by setting the ISensors HAL into DATA_INJECTION mode.

methods.name: getSensorHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the handle for a specific sensor type from the sensors list.

methods.name: endSensorInjection
methods.description: Resets the sensor HAL back to NORMAL mode after injection.

methods.name: InjectOrientation
methods.description: Injects accelerometer data to simulate device orientation based on rotation degrees.

methods.name: InjectAccelerometer
methods.description: Injects accelerometer sensor data with specified x, y, z values.

methods.name: InjectMagnetometer
methods.description: Injects magnetometer sensor data with specified x, y, z values.

methods.name: InjectGyroscope
methods.description: Injects gyroscope sensor data with specified x, y, z values.

methods.name: InjectHingeAngle
methods.description: Injects a hinge angle sensor event with a specified angle.
